description: The launcher replacing itself on macOS: two launchers packaged by tools/ci/release_launcher.sh from one build directory (old_version, new_version), a local release server listing the new one first; the old one installed in a scratch home's Applications and opened by LaunchServices with --update-launcher must download, check, unpack, codesign-verify, swap and relaunch; the new one must open by itself, remove the copy set aside and carry no quarantine flag; a launcher in a folder this account cannot change must refuse with the sentence; the user's own launcher data is untouched.
must_log: check: {new} is newer than {old} ({new} is listed before {old}, newest first)
after the relaunch: the replaced copy was removed
refusal_line: The launcher is in {home_locked}, which this account cannot change.
